📖 How to use

  1. Paste or type your text into the text area.
  2. Set a minimum word length and choose whether to ignore case and remove stopwords.
  3. Click "Analyze" to see the top 30 words.
  4. Hover or read the counts and bars to spot which words dominate your text.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as a word?

A word is any run of letters plus apostrophes (so "don't" counts as one word). Numbers and punctuation are ignored.

What does "remove stopwords" do?

Stopwords are the most common filler words like "the", "and" and "is". Removing them surfaces the meaningful content words in your text.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

Yes. Everything runs in your browser with JavaScript — your text is never sent to any server.
